entries.name: Master of Information Technology
entries.reason: No live mit.edu.au course page under any current URL scheme (checked the full site course-navigation footer on every fetched page, which lists MIT's entire current catalogue by faculty, and it is absent), absent from the international tuition-fees schedule at /study-with-us/tuition-fees (which prices every one of the other 14 current courses), no Wayback Machine capture under the current /study-with-us/programs/ URL scheme, and absent from both TEQSA's accredited and previously-accredited course lists for Melbourne Institute of Technology Pty Ltd (PRV12138). Decisively absent from the CRICOS institution course list for provider 01545C (cricos.education.gov.au, Institution Search), which lists exactly 14 AQF-level courses at the Melbourne location, all 14 matching MIT's other 14 currently-published rows one-for-one, with no Master of Information Technology entry among them. No evidence this exact-named award has ever existed under MIT's current (post-2015) URL/CRICOS structure; not a discontinuation of a recently-real course but a name with no current or recent real offering to source.
